SELECT heavy_atoms, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb11 WHERE heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many coal-fired units reported to EPA's Clean Air Markets programs in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type LIKE 'Coal%'
Which grids imported the most electricity from their neighbours in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(-sum(try_cast(total_interchange_mw AS double))) AS net_imports_mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of 2022's fatal crashes happened after dark?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(lgt_condname LIKE 'Dark%') / count(*), 1) AS pct_dark FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which cities are home to the patent owners with the most U.S. patents?

SELECT l.disambig_city AS city, l.disambig_country AS country, count(DISTINCT a.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_location_disambiguated l ON l.location_id = a.location_id WHERE a.disambig_assignee_organization <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York City's highest hourly electricity load in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name LIKE 'N.Y.C%' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which states have the most regulation sections on file?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE document_type = 'regulation' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median age of people living in Maine?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US23' AND variable = 'B01002_E001'
Which specialties have the most clinicians opting out of Medicare?
SELECT specialty, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE specialty IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of the Texas grid's generation came from wind in 2023?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_wind_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double))) / sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw AS double)), 1) AS wind_pct FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'ERCO' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
In which states do the most workers work from home?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B08006_E017' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B08006_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_work_from_home FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b08006' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Are there more boys or girls in American public schools?

SELECT sex, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(student_count AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which larger auto insurers had the worst complaint ratios in New York in 2024?
New York Auto Insurer Complaint Rankings

SELECT company_name, try_cast(ratio AS double) AS complaint_ratio FROM govblock_insurance_filings.ny_auto_insurer_complaint_rankings WHERE filing_year = '2024' AND try_cast(premiums_written_in_millions AS double) >= 10 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the most solar power the Texas grid produced in one hour in its hourly solar report?
Ercot Hourly Solar Report Cdr Pvgrhrlyavgactnp
SELECT max(try_cast(system_wide_gen AS double)) AS peak_solar_mw FROM govblock_solar.ercot_hourly_solar_report_cdr_pvgrhrlyavgactnp
Which states have the most citizens of voting age?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many adverse drug event reports received in 2019 involved a death?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_event WHERE seriousnessdeath = '1' AND substr(receivedate, 1, 4) = '2019'
Which reactors were shut down for the longest stretch in 2022?
SELECT trim(unit) AS unit, count(*) AS days_at_zero FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2022 %' AND try_cast(power AS double) = 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has nuclear power's share of New York's generation moved from year to year?

SELECT substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) AS year, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN fuel_category = 'Nuclear' THEN try_cast(gen_mw AS double) END) / sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)), 1) AS nuclear_pct FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
What types of compliance inspection are most common under the Clean Water Act?
SELECT comp_monitor_type_desc, count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did U.S. coal consumption change from 2005 to 2023?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.CLTCB.US.A' AND period IN ('2005', '2023') ORDER BY 1
Where is homeownership highest among the states?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B25003_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B25003_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_owner_occupied FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25003' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the price power plants paid for natural gas change from January to December 2020?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT month, avg(try_cast(fuel_cost AS double)) AS avg_cost FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE fuel_group = 'Natural Gas' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND try_cast(month AS integer) IN (1, 12) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY try_cast(month AS integer) LIMIT 10
Which counties gained the most people in 2025?
SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(npopchg2025 AS double) AS change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did U.S. crude oil exports change from January 2015 to January 2024?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_barrels_per_day FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.MCREXUS2.M' AND period IN ('201501', '202401') ORDER BY 1
What ranks of position are advertised most often in physics job listings?
SELECT ranks, count(*) AS jobs FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_jobs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many business establishments were there in Harris County, Texas, at the end of 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry
SELECT try_cast(qtrly_estabs AS double) AS establishments FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '48201' AND own_code = '0' AND industry_code = '10' AND year = '2023' AND qtr = '4'
On what grounds do federal civil cases most often claim jurisdiction?
SELECT jurisdiction_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE jurisdiction_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of recorded patent assignments are employees assigning inventions to their employer?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(employer_assign = '1') / count(*), 1) AS pct_employer FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignment_conveyance
Which federal information collections cost the government the most each year?
SELECT title, try_cast(annualfederalcostamount AS double) AS annual_cost FROM govblock_executive.oira_pra_inventory ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rural health clinic cost reports cover fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_rhc17_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Among the most specific research concepts, which have the most works?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_concepts WHERE cast(level AS varchar) = '5' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many votes were cast for president in Wisconsin in 2016?
SELECT sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'WISCONSIN' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2016'
Which kinds of provider are most common among those enrolled in Medicare?
Medicare Fee For Service Public Provider Enrollment
SELECT provider_type_desc, count(*) AS providers FROM govblock_health.cms_medicare_fee_for_service_public_provider_enrollment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much NIH money went to Johns Hopkins University in fiscal year 2020?
SELECT sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_name = 'JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2020'
Where in a patent are compounds found most often: description, claims, abstract, title or images?

SELECT f.field_name, count(*) AS mentions FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patent_compound_map AS m JOIN govblock_chemistry.surechembl_fields AS f ON cast(f.id AS varchar) = cast(m.field_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Georgia's 2020 presidential vote was cast by mail?

SELECT mode, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'GEORGIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which nuclear reactors spent the most days completely shut down in 2023?
SELECT trim(unit) AS reactor, count(*) AS days_at_zero FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2023 %' AND try_cast(power AS double) = 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many different marketplace plans were sold in Texas in 2021?
SELECT count(DISTINCT planid) AS plans FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE statecode = 'TX' AND cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021'
